title: Les 05 PT: Twee LANs via Eén Cisco Router (Subnets & Routing)
instructions:
## Les 05 PT: 2 LAN's via 1 router
**Cursus:** PXL Network Essentials (Gert Van Waeyenberg) • [vwgert.github.io/networksess/Les05_PT_1router.html](https://vwgert.github.io/networksess/Les05_PT_1router.html)

### Adreseringstabel:
| Toestel | Interface | IP-adres | Subnetmasker | Default Gateway |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **R1** | GigabitEthernet0/0/0 | `192.168.1.1` | `255.255.255.0` | - |
| **R1** | GigabitEthernet0/0/1 | `10.0.1.1`    | `255.255.255.0` | - |
| **Laptop0** | FastEthernet0 | `192.168.1.10` | `255.255.255.0` | `192.168.1.1` |
| **PC0**     | FastEthernet0 | `10.0.1.100`   | `255.255.255.0` | `10.0.1.1` |

### Opdrachten:
1. Configureer `R1` (Cisco 4331):
   ```cisco
   enable
   configure terminal
   hostname R1
   interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
    ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
    no shutdown
   interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
    ip address 10.0.1.1 255.255.255.0
    no shutdown
   exit
   ```
2. Test inter-LAN routering met ping van `Laptop0` naar `PC0` (`10.0.1.100`).
